alternatives_rejected.why: Its latency deviation (z about 455) is about half of productcatalogservice's (z about 945) in E1. Calls into productcatalogservice slowed 83.7x (E2), so recommendationservice's latency is consistent with it waiting on a slow productcatalogservice. A per-service trace check on recommendationservice was not run to confirm this.

Its own span self-time barely changed (0.01->0.02ms, E2), and no CPU metric shows up among the top deviations of the unfiltered ranking (E1). CPU saturation would slow its own processing; here only the caller-observed time grew (2.42->202.98ms, E2), which points to network delay.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect productcatalogservice's network path for injected delay (e.g. a tc/netem qdisc on its pod interface or a chaos experiment) and remove it. Restart the productcatalogservice pod if needed. Afterwards, confirm that caller-observed latency is back to about 2ms p50.
